caption.text:
Every rival answered more power with all-wheel drive. Honda kept solving the harder problem.

The front-wheel-drive benchmark, sharpened again.

· 315 hp through the front axle alone, held by a helical limited-slip differential.
· Dual-axis front struts separate steering from suspension load, which is why the power doesn't tug at the wheel.
· 169 mph and 5.0 seconds to 60 mph, with three pedals and no automatic offered.

2025 Honda Civic Type R FL5
315 hp · 310 lb-ft · 0–60 mph in 5.0 sec · 2.0 L VTEC turbo

The front-wheel-drive ceiling keeps moving, and it's Honda that keeps moving it.

Has front-wheel drive hit its ceiling, or has Honda just raised it again?
